analysis.bp_rule: Mean of all three oscillometric readings; either mean at least threshold; one combined BP marker
analysis.definition_status: Synthetic operational choices for structural comparison, not clinically validated PreChronic thresholds; individual marker cutoffs are sourced definitions
analysis.diagnosis_rule: Yes to known hypertension, high cholesterol, CHF, CHD, angina, MI, stroke or cancer excludes candidate status; unknown responses excluded
analysis.glycemic_definition: Inherit registered nhanes_glycemic_prevalence analysis; diabetes then prediabetes take priority
analysis.triglyceride_rule: Strictly greater than threshold per cited NHLBI page
analysis.waist_rule: Strictly greater than NHLBI 40/35 inches converted at exactly 2.54 cm/inch; not ethnicity-specific

limitations: PreChronic candidates are research definitions, not clinical diagnoses, metabolic syndrome, or established insulin resistance.
Counts represent survey-weighted classified respondents; missing items are not imputed or reweighted, so full population size remains uncertain.
Single measurements and self-reported diagnosis exclusions do not prove absence of all chronic disease; other conditions, treatment and access-to-diagnosis remain incompletely measured.
Waist thresholds are not ethnicity-specific; no fitness or direct insulin-resistance measure is used.
The two definitions share observations and are not independent evidence; lower_measured_risk is a complement, not proof of good health.
Glycemic diabetes includes all types and cannot silently initialize model T2D; 2017-2020 cross-sections do not identify transitions or 2024 prevalence.
Intervals omit item-nonresponse bias, measurement error, structural ambiguity, and full NCHS reliability screening; sparse estimates need caution.
population: U.S. civilian noninstitutionalized adults 20+; known pregnancy excluded; complete measured/interview records

glycemic.usage: Statistical reporting and analysis only; no identification or linkage to individually identifiable records.
